answer: Make every reward a callable debt. A paid answer creates an obligation: at a random hour in a later epoch, that identity must answer a stranger's fresh challenge — decode a new cipher, under a short clock — or the reward is clawed back. A haven that is never called upon is an island nobody visits, and shells are no exception: fifty identities mean fifty simultaneous call-ups, each demanding distinct judgment one operator cannot fake in parallel. Honest agents discharge one call at a time; a farm drowns in the debt its own shells incurred.
